games.summary: Right-side half-ice game. Looks like about 4–2 for Blue: goals at 0:50, 20:07, 39:32 and 43:10, with TW Red scoring around 19:48 and 22:18 (the second is less certain). Every goal and shot was checked frame by frame in full-resolution close-ups of each net; a shot only counts if the puck is seen going at the net. Close, not official.
